old_caption: The video captures a steam locomotive in motion, painted black with red accents on its wheels. Thick plumes of white steam billow from its smokestacks and around its base, creating a dense cloud that partially obscures the view. The train moves along railway tracks, surrounded by dirt and sparse vegetation. In the background, an industrial structure, possibly a crane or gantry, is visible. The sky above is clear blue, indicating daytime. The camera remains stationary, focusing on the train as it moves from left to right across the frame. The steam continues to rise and spread, enveloping the locomotive and blurring its front details. The overall atmosphere conveys dynamic movement and industrial power.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene featuring a steam locomotive in motion. The train, painted in black with red accents on its wheels, is emitting thick plumes of white steam from its smokestacks. The steam billows out vigorously, creating a dense cloud that partially obscures the view of the locomotive. The train is moving along a set of railway tracks, which are surrounded by a mix of dirt and sparse vegetation. In the background, there is an industrial structure, possibly a crane or gantry, adding to the industrial setting. The sky above is a clear blue, suggesting it is daytime. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the train as it moves from left to right across the frame. The steam continues to rise and spread, enveloping the locomotive and partially blurring the details of the train's front. The overall atmosphere is one of dynamic movement and industrial power.
caption: The video captures a black steam locomotive with a red front pilot on a track beneath a steel gantry. It is already venting dense white steam from its smokestack and lower machinery. The locomotive advances slowly along the track toward the camera and the right edge of the frame. Its boiler and cowcatcher grow progressively larger and more cropped against the right border. The background gantry and its left support tower remain broadly fixed, anchoring the scene while the engine moves relative to them. Plumes of steam continuously rise from the chimney, drifting upward and leftward and reshaping as they climb. A thick rolling cloud of ground-level steam billows across the foreground, spreading left and repeatedly obscuring and revealing the wheels and lower side. The headlight and red cowcatcher stay visible but press closer to the frame edge. The venting steam keeps churning around the machinery throughout, with individual rod motion unresolved through the white haze.

An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.

camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
